originalTitle: Raymond Realty Q1 net profit falls 19 pc to Rs 13.43 cr on higher expenses
simplifiedContent: Raymond Realty, a real estate company, made less profit in the first quarter of the year (19% less) because it spent more on operating costs. However, the company's total income actually increased to Rs 535.71 crore. This is a significant change from the same time last year. The company also had a good start to the year in terms of selling properties, with sales bookings of Rs 700 crore, which is much higher than the Rs 306 crore they had last year. This matters because it shows how the company is performing financially, and the increased sales bookings could be a positive sign for its future growth.

originalTitle: Gold hits seven-week high as weak U.S. jobs data dents rate hike bets
simplifiedContent: The price of gold recently reached its highest point in seven weeks. This happened because the US reported losing more jobs than expected, which makes it less likely that interest rates will increase soon. As a result, gold is becoming more attractive to investors compared to other investments that earn interest. This trend is also helping other precious metals like silver and platinum increase in price. Overall, gold is having its best week in seven months, which is good news for people who have invested in it.

originalTitle: Airbnb shares surge 15% to four-year high on raised forecast, AI gains
simplifiedContent: Airbnb's stock price jumped up 15% to its highest point in four years. This happened because the company said it thinks it will make more money this year than it previously thought, due to people still wanting to travel and the company using artificial intelligence to work more efficiently. The company also made more money than expected in the last quarter and spent less on customer support, which made investors feel more confident. This is important because it shows that Airbnb is doing well and investors are excited about its future, which is why the stock price went up. The increase in stock price is a good sign for people who already own Airbnb stock.

originalTitle: Cupid net profit jumps 194% YoY to  ₹44 crore in Q1 as margins expand sharply; raises FY27 guidance
simplifiedContent: Here's the news in simple terms: Cupid, a company, made a lot more money in the first quarter of the year compared to the same time last year. Specifically, their net profit (or total earnings) jumped by 194% to ₹44 crore. This is a big increase, and it's because their healthcare business is doing really well, both in India and in other countries. The company's total sales (or revenue) also went up by 142% to ₹157 crore, which is a significant rise. This is a positive sign for the company, and it suggests that they're doing well and may continue to do so.

originalTitle: Airbnb shares surge 16% to 4-year high on Q2 beat; full-year outlook raised for second time
simplifiedContent: Airbnb's stock price went up 16% to $176.20, which is the highest it has been in four years. This happened because the company had better-than-expected results for the second quarter, with $3.6 billion in revenue and more bookings. The company saw strong growth in important markets, which is a good sign for its business. As a result, Airbnb is now expecting to do better for the rest of the year, which is why it raised its outlook for the second time. This is significant because it shows that despite some global concerns, people are still traveling and using Airbnb's services.

originalTitle: Pulse of the Street: Small-caps steal the show as equities extend gains
simplifiedContent: The stock market had a good week, with two important groups of stocks called "benchmarks" going up in value. The benchmarks are like scores that show how well the market is doing, and they increased by 0.51% and 0.76% respectively. This means that people who invested in these stocks made a small profit. Small companies, also known as "small-caps", did particularly well, which is unusual and notable. This upward trend in the market is a positive sign for investors, indicating that the market is continuing to grow.
